sub3011: A person awakes from a dream and
tries to remember details of it
but they disappear.
It involved a rabbit and tea and made me think of Alice in wonderland.
The person sees a bird and
says hello.
The person then realises that they are hungry and
the bird flies off and returns with a beak full of berries.
The person eats the berries and finds them surprisingly filling.
They save some for later, putting them in their pocket.
The bird then brings a vial of a fragrant liquid.
The two sing the bird's song -
this is when the person realises that they are thirsty and
prompts the bird to fetch the liquid.
The singing is not good and
the bird gets offended by something that the person says and
calls them "Specieist".
The person then attempts to sleep in the dark and scary woods
and falls into another Alice in Wonderland themed dream involving best friend Mary Anne and a game of hide and seek.
A small door leads to a tunnel
which leads to a field full of children in white and
an old man in white-
we learn that this is England.
Suddenly the person wakes and sees a huge hound.
They run away and
seek sanctuary in the house of an old man
who is entranced by the person's face.
We learn that the person is the heir to the throne and
had been put to sleep in a locked room to await the age when he could rule the kingdom.
The berries from the pocket are the reason the hound is chasing him and
they are then thrown away.
sub3015: There was a person who was dreaming
but they were soon awakened by the feeling of an object on their chest.
It ended up being a bird.
The person's stomach was growling
so the bird went and brought back some berries.
The bird begins to speak to this person and
also brought them water so they were able to sing with the bird.
Soon the person started to get sleepy and began to dream.
They began dreaming about running from their friend,
assuming they were playing hide and seek.
The person runs into their friend Mary Ann and
they disperse.
Soon the person finds a door.
He enters it and
is greeted with darkness.
He sees a light above and
begins to move towards it as they are there looking.
He eventually drugs down and awakens from their sleep.
Hounds were in his face and
he begins running away.
He reaches a man's door
who tells him to throw out his houndberries and
he does so into the woods.
The man notices that he is the heir of royal family.
The person does not remember it
but is excited for the respect and power.
The man allows him to sleep at his place.
